en: I thought we agreed to push the deadline to Friday, but now it sounds like some people still expect it by Wednesday.
zh: 我以为我们已经同意把截止日期推迟到星期五，但现在听起来有些人仍然期望在星期三之前完成。

en: If the client doesn't confirm by noon, we should probably postpone the kickoff until next week.
zh: 如果客户在中午之前没有确认，我们可能应该把启动会推迟到下周。

en: She said she might join the call, but only if her earlier meeting doesn't run over.
zh: 她说她可能会加入通话，但前提是她之前的会议不会超时。

en: We have three items on the agenda, not four, and the last one is just a quick update.
zh: 我们的议程上有三项，不是四项，最后一项只是快速更新。

en: Can you send the invite to everyone except the interns? They don't need to be in this one.
zh: 你能把邀请发给除了实习生以外的所有人吗？他们不需要参加这一次。

en: I'm not sure the room is available at 2, so let's have a backup plan just in case.
zh: 我不确定两点时会议室是否可用，所以我们还是准备一个备用方案以防万一。

en: He usually joins from his phone, so don't be surprised if his video doesn't work.
zh: 他通常用手机加入，所以如果他的视频不能用，别感到意外。

en: We can either meet in person or online, but I'd prefer online since half the team is remote.
zh: 我们可以线下见面，也可以线上开会，但我更倾向于线上，因为团队里有一半人远程。

en: Unless something urgent comes up, I'll be there about ten minutes early.
zh: 除非有紧急情况出现，否则我会提前大约十分钟到。

en: The meeting isn't canceled; it's just moved to Thursday at 3:30 instead of 2.
zh: 会议没有取消，只是改到了星期四3:30，而不是2点。

en: I don't think we need a full hour for this, maybe thirty minutes is enough.
zh: 我觉得我们不需要整整一个小时，也许三十分钟就够了。

en: If you can't make it, please send your notes beforehand so we can still discuss them.
zh: 如果你来不了，请提前把你的笔记发过来，这样我们仍然可以讨论。

en: She asked whether we could shift the stand-up to 9:15, but I haven't heard back from the others yet.
zh: 她问我们能不能把站会改到9:15，但我还没有收到其他人的回复。

en: We should keep the meeting short because two people have another call right after.
zh: 我们应该把会议开短一点，因为两个人紧接着还有另一个电话。

en: It's not that I disagree with the plan; I just think we're missing a step.
zh: 不是说我不同意这个计划，我只是觉得我们漏了一个步骤。

en: Let's not decide today. We can revisit it next Monday after everyone has had time to think.
zh: 我们今天先别决定。下周一等大家都有时间思考之后，我们可以再讨论。

en: He said he'd handle the slides, but I'm not sure he remembers, so maybe send him a reminder.
zh: 他说他会处理幻灯片，但我不确定他还记不记得，所以也许给他发个提醒。

en: The conference room is booked until 11, so we'll start in the small meeting room and move later.
zh: 会议室被订到11点，所以我们先在小会议室开始，之后再换过去。

en: I can only stay for the first twenty minutes, but I'll read the minutes afterward.
zh: 我只能待前二十分钟，但之后我会看会议纪要。

en: If nobody objects, I'll go ahead and send the calendar invite for Friday at 10.
zh: 如果没有人反对，我就直接发出星期五10点的日历邀请。

en: We don't have to finish everything today; the main goal is just to agree on priorities.
zh: 我们不必今天完成所有事情；主要目标只是就优先事项达成一致。

en: She might be late because her previous meeting often goes over by five or ten minutes.
zh: 她可能会迟到，因为她之前的会议经常会超时五到十分钟。

en: Can we move the review to next Tuesday? I'm traveling Monday and won't be able to prepare.
zh: 我们能把评审改到下周二吗？我周一出差，没法准备。

en: I thought the deadline was the 15th, not the 5th, so we may have more time than we think.
zh: 我以为截止日期是15号，不是5号，所以我们可能比想象中有更多时间。

en: Unless the manager says otherwise, we'll keep the same schedule for now.
zh: 除非经理另有指示，否则我们暂时保持同样的日程。

en: He didn't say he couldn't come; he just said he might be a few minutes late.
zh: 他没说他来不了，他只是说他可能会晚几分钟。

en: We need to decide between the 10th and the 17th, but I don't have a strong preference.
zh: 我们需要在10号和17号之间做决定，但我没有强烈的偏好。

en: If the update takes longer than expected, we can skip the last item and follow up by email.
zh: 如果更新耗时超过预期，我们可以跳过最后一项，然后通过邮件跟进。

en: I'm not available at 4, but I could do 4:30 or anytime after 5.
zh: 我4点没空，但4:30或者5点之后任何时间都可以。

en: She usually takes notes, so if she's absent, someone else should volunteer.
zh: 她通常会做笔记，所以如果她缺席，应该有人主动承担。

en: Let's start with the budget, not the timeline, because the numbers may change everything else.
zh: 我们先从预算开始，而不是时间线，因为数字可能会改变其他所有事情。

en: I doubt we'll finish in thirty minutes, but we can try to keep it under forty-five.
zh: 我怀疑我们三十分钟内完不成，但我们可以尽量控制在四十五分钟以内。

en: If you're joining remotely, please mute your mic unless you're speaking.
zh: 如果你是远程加入，请在不发言时静音。

en: He asked if we could meet at 8 instead of 9, but that's too early for most of us.
zh: 他问我们能不能8点见面而不是9点，但这对我们大多数人来说太早了。

en: We should probably cancel the Friday sync since half the team will be out.
zh: 我们也许应该取消周五的同步会，因为团队里有一半人不在。

en: I'm not saying the idea is bad; I'm just saying we need more data before we commit.
zh: 我不是说这个想法不好；我只是说在投入之前我们需要更多数据。

en: Can you check whether the 14th works for everyone, or if we should aim for the 21st?
zh: 你能确认一下14号是否对所有人都合适，还是我们应该定在21号？

en: Unless traffic is terrible, I should be there by 9:05.
zh: 除非交通非常糟糕，否则我应该在9:05之前到。

en: She might not have seen the invite yet, so don't assume she's ignoring it.
zh: 她可能还没看到邀请，所以别以为她是故意不理。

en: We have two options: shorten the meeting or move it to a day when more people can attend.
zh: 我们有两个选择：缩短会议，或者把它改到更多人能参加的那一天。

en: I'll be late, maybe ten minutes... start without me if I'm not there by 2:10.
zh: 我会迟到，也许十分钟……如果我2:10还没到，你们就先开始吧。

en: Not today... let's talk about it tomorrow when we have the full team.
zh: 不是今天……我们明天等全队都在的时候再谈吧。

en: If only we had booked the room earlier...
zh: 要是我们早点订了会议室就好了……

en: Three people, not five, confirmed for Friday.
zh: 确认参加周五的是三个人，不是五个人。

en: Half an hour, maybe less.
zh: 半小时，也许更少。

en: Before 9, if possible...
zh: 如果可能的话，9点之前……

en: No later than the 12th, preferably the 10th.
zh: 不晚于12号，最好是10号。

en: Not sure yet—depends on the client.
zh: 还不确定——取决于客户。

en: Two o'clock works, but not three.
zh: 两点可以，但三点不行。

en: If she can't join... we'll reschedule.
zh: 如果她不能参加……我们就重新安排。

en: I thought the new dashboard would make things easier, but honestly, it just buries the most important numbers three clicks deep.
zh: 我本以为新仪表盘会让事情更简单，但说实话，它只是把最重要的数字埋到了三次点击之后。

en: If the user can't find the save button within five seconds, we've probably failed, no matter how elegant the layout looks.
zh: 如果用户五秒钟内找不到保存按钮，那不管布局看起来多优雅，我们大概都失败了。

en: The prototype isn't finished yet, so don't show it to the client until we fix the navigation...
zh: 原型还没完成，所以在修好导航之前不要给客户看……

en: Half the test group preferred the blue button, while the other half didn't even notice it changed.
zh: 测试组里有一半人更喜欢蓝色按钮，而另一半人根本没注意到它变了。

en: We measured the tap target at 44 pixels, but on smaller phones it shrinks to about 32, which is below the recommended minimum.
zh: 我们测得点击目标是44像素，但在较小的手机上它会缩小到大约32像素，低于推荐的最小值。

en: Don't assume people read the tooltip; most of them just tap around until something works.
zh: 别以为人们会读工具提示；大多数人只是到处点，直到某个东西能用。

en: It's not that the feature is useless, it's that nobody can figure out when to use it.
zh: 不是这个功能没用，而是没人能弄明白什么时候该用它。

en: Maybe we should move the search bar to the top, or maybe that would just confuse returning users.
zh: 也许我们应该把搜索栏移到顶部，或者也许那只会让老用户困惑。

en: The onboarding flow takes about two minutes if everything goes smoothly, but it can stretch to ten when the verification email is slow.
zh: 如果一切顺利，引导流程大约需要两分钟，但当验证邮件很慢时，它可能拖到十分钟。

en: Unless we simplify the checkout page, we're going to keep losing customers at the last step.
zh: 除非我们简化结账页面，否则我们会继续在最后一步流失客户。

en: I can't tell whether the icon means settings or profile, and I've been using this app for a year.
zh: 我分不清这个图标是表示设置还是个人资料，而我已经用这个应用一年了。

en: The font size is fine on desktop, but on mobile it's almost unreadable without zooming in.
zh: 字号在桌面上没问题，但在手机上不放大几乎无法阅读。

en: We ran the A/B test for two weeks, but the results weren't statistically significant, so we can't really conclude anything.
zh: 我们进行了两周的A/B测试，但结果没有统计显著性，所以我们其实无法得出任何结论。

en: If you hide the advanced options, power users will complain; if you show them, beginners will feel overwhelmed.
zh: 如果你隐藏高级选项，高级用户会抱怨；如果你显示它们，初学者会感到不知所措。

en: The error message says 'something went wrong,' which tells the user absolutely nothing useful.
zh: 错误信息写着“出了点问题”，这对用户完全没有提供任何有用的信息。

en: Click the gear icon, then choose privacy... no wait, that's the old version.
zh: 点击齿轮图标，然后选择隐私……不，等等，那是旧版本。

en: Our accessibility audit found 17 issues, but only 3 of them are actually blocking screen reader users.
zh: 我们的无障碍审计发现了17个问题，但其中只有3个真正阻碍了屏幕阅读器用户。

en: The color contrast ratio is 3.2 to 1, which fails the WCAG AA standard for normal text.
zh: 颜色对比度是3.2比1，不符合WCAG AA对普通文本的标准。

en: Users don't want more features; they want fewer steps to get the same result.
zh: 用户不想要更多功能；他们想要更少的步骤来达到同样的结果。

en: I'm not sure the tooltip is necessary, but removing it might make the form feel less friendly.
zh: 我不确定工具提示是否必要，但移除它可能会让表单显得不那么友好。

en: The loading spinner appears for 800 milliseconds, then disappears before the content actually loads.
zh: 加载旋转图标出现800毫秒，然后在内容真正加载之前就消失了。

en: If the user has to read a manual, the design has already failed.
zh: 如果用户必须阅读手册，那设计就已经失败了。

en: We tested it with 12 people, and 9 of them missed the 'next' button entirely.
zh: 我们用12个人进行了测试，其中9个人完全没看到“下一步”按钮。

en: The button looks clickable, but it isn't... that's a dark pattern, even if we didn't mean it.
zh: 这个按钮看起来可以点击，但其实不能……那是暗黑模式，即使我们不是故意的。

en: Don't put important actions in the bottom right corner; thumbs don't reach there comfortably.
zh: 不要把重要操作放在右下角；拇指够不到那里，不舒服。

en: The search results are sorted by relevance, not by date, unless the user changes the filter.
zh: 搜索结果按相关性排序，而不是按日期，除非用户更改筛选器。

en: It works perfectly on my machine, but on older browsers it breaks completely.
zh: 在我的机器上运行完美，但在较旧的浏览器上它完全崩溃。

en: We need to decide whether to use a modal or a new page, and neither option is clearly better.
zh: 我们需要决定是使用模态框还是新页面，而这两个选项都没有明显更好。

en: The user didn't understand the difference between 'save' and 'submit,' so they lost their work.
zh: 用户不理解“保存”和“提交”的区别，所以他们丢失了工作内容。

en: If we add a progress bar, people might wait longer, but they'll also be less frustrated.
zh: 如果我们添加进度条，人们可能会等待更久，但他们也会少一些挫败感。

en: The form has 23 fields, but only 7 are actually required.
zh: 表单有23个字段，但实际只有7个是必填的。

en: I can't reproduce the bug on my phone, but three users reported it on Android 11.
zh: 我在手机上无法复现这个错误，但有三名用户在Android 11上报告了它。

en: The menu closes when you tap outside it, which is fine, but it also closes when you scroll.
zh: 点击菜单外部时菜单会关闭，这没问题，但滚动时它也会关闭。

en: Unless we test with real content, we won't know if the layout holds up.
zh: 除非我们用真实内容测试，否则我们不会知道布局是否撑得住。

en: The icon is a floppy disk, which means nothing to anyone under 25.
zh: 图标是一张软盘，这对25岁以下的人来说毫无意义。

en: We could use a dropdown, or we could use radio buttons... it depends on how many options there are.
zh: 我们可以用下拉菜单，或者用单选按钮……这取决于有多少个选项。

en: The page loads in 1.2 seconds on wifi, but on 3G it takes almost 8 seconds.
zh: 页面在WiFi上加载需要1.2秒，但在3G上几乎需要8秒。

en: Don't make the user remember information from a previous screen; show it again if necessary.
zh: 不要让用户记住前一屏幕的信息；如有必要，再显示一次。

en: The tooltip says 'click here,' but there are three 'here's on the same page.
zh: 工具提示写着“点击这里”，但同一页面上有三个“这里”。

en: I'm not convinced the new color scheme improves readability, but it does look more modern.
zh: 我不确信新配色方案提高了可读性，但它看起来确实更现代。

en: If the password requirements aren't shown upfront, users will fail twice before succeeding.
zh: 如果密码要求没有提前显示，用户会失败两次才能成功。

en: The notification badge shows 5, but when you open the app there are only 2 new items.
zh: 通知徽章显示5，但当你打开应用时只有2条新内容。

en: We should probably remove the 'cancel' button, or at least make it less prominent...
zh: 我们也许应该移除“取消”按钮，或者至少让它不那么显眼……

en: The drag-and-drop feature doesn't work on touchscreens, which is a problem for half our users.
zh: 拖放功能在触摸屏上不起作用，这对我们一半的用户来说是个问题。

en: It's not obvious that the list is scrollable, so people think they've seen everything.
zh: 列表可以滚动这一点并不明显，所以人们以为他们已经看到了全部内容。

en: We need a fallback for when JavaScript is disabled, even if only 1% of users do that.
zh: 我们需要为禁用JavaScript的情况提供后备方案，即使只有1%的用户会那样做。

en: The confirmation dialog uses 'OK' and 'Cancel,' which are ambiguous without context.
zh: 确认对话框使用“确定”和“取消”，在没有上下文的情况下这些词很模糊。

en: If the user has to scroll horizontally, the table is too wide for mobile.
zh: 如果用户必须水平滚动，那表格对手机来说就太宽了。

en: The animation lasts 400 milliseconds, which feels smooth, but anything longer feels sluggish.
zh: 动画持续400毫秒，感觉流畅，但再长一点就会显得迟钝。

en: I think we should test the prototype with five users before writing any code...
zh: 我认为我们应该在写任何代码之前用五名用户测试原型……

en: We're not cutting the marketing budget this quarter, but we might freeze new hires until revenue stabilizes.
zh: 我们这个季度不会削减营销预算，但可能会冻结新员工招聘，直到收入稳定下来。

en: If the forecast holds, we'll finish the year about twelve percent above target. If it doesn't, well, we'll deal with that later.
zh: 如果预测准确，我们年底会比目标高出大约百分之十二。如果不准，嗯，那就到时候再说吧。

en: The finance team says we have roughly three months of runway left, maybe four if collections improve.
zh: 财务团队说我们大约还剩三个月的资金，如果回款改善的话也许能有四个月。

en: I don't think the board will approve a budget that big unless we show them a credible path to profitability.
zh: 我觉得除非我们给董事会展示一条可信的盈利路径，否则他们不会批准那么大的预算。

en: Our vendor costs went up eighteen percent last year, and honestly, nobody saw that coming.
zh: 我们去年的供应商成本上涨了百分之十八，说实话，谁都没预料到。

en: Can you send me the revised projections before Friday? I need to review them over the weekend.
zh: 你能在周五之前把修订后的预测发给我吗？我需要周末看一下。

en: We overspent on travel by about forty thousand dollars, which isn't huge, but it's not nothing either.
zh: 我们在差旅上超支了大约四万美元，这不算多，但也不是小数目。

en: Unless the exchange rate shifts dramatically, we should be fine through the end of the fiscal year.
zh: 除非汇率出现剧烈波动，否则我们到财年结束应该都没问题。

en: The client hasn't confirmed the contract yet, so I wouldn't count that revenue in the forecast.
zh: 客户还没有确认合同，所以我不会把那笔收入算进预测里。

en: Look, I'm not saying the numbers are wrong... I'm just saying I don't fully understand how we got here.
zh: 你看，我不是说这些数字有问题……我只是说我不太明白我们是怎么走到这一步的。

en: Half the department thinks we should invest in new software, and the other half thinks we should save the cash.
zh: 部门里一半的人认为我们应该投资新软件，另一半则认为我们应该把现金存起来。

en: Our biggest expense is still payroll, which eats up nearly sixty percent of monthly revenue.
zh: 我们最大的开支仍然是工资，它占了月收入的将近百分之六十。

en: If we delay the product launch by one quarter, we save money now but lose market share later.
zh: 如果我们把产品发布推迟一个季度，现在能省钱，但以后会失去市场份额。

en: She's cautiously optimistic about next year's growth, though she warned that nothing is guaranteed.
zh: 她对明年的增长持谨慎乐观的态度，不过她警告说没有什么是有保证的。

en: We need to trim about fifteen percent from operating costs without laying anyone off. That's the challenge.
zh: 我们需要在不裁员的情况下把运营成本削减大约百分之十五。这就是挑战所在。

en: I've seen the preliminary numbers, and they're not great, but they're not catastrophic either.
zh: 我看过初步数据了，不算好，但也不算灾难性的。

en: The auditors are coming next month, so please make sure every receipt is accounted for.
zh: 审计人员下个月就来，所以请确保每一张收据都有据可查。

en: Honestly, I'd rather underpromise and overdeliver than promise something we can't actually achieve.
zh: 说实话，我宁愿少承诺多兑现，也不愿承诺一些我们实际上做不到的事情。

en: If interest rates go up again, our loan payments could increase by several thousand a month.
zh: 如果利率再次上升，我们的贷款月供可能会增加几千美元。

en: They projected a ten percent increase in sales, but actual results came in at only three percent.
zh: 他们预测销售额增长百分之十，但实际结果只有百分之三。

en: We can't keep burning cash at this rate. Either we raise another round or we cut deeper.
zh: 我们不能继续以这个速度烧钱了。要么再融一轮资，要么削减得更狠。

en: The quarterly report is due in two weeks, and I still don't have the regional breakdowns.
zh: 季度报告两周后就要交，可我还没有各地区的明细数据。

en: It's not that we don't have the money... it's that we don't have the money to waste.
zh: 不是我们没有钱……而是我们没有钱可以浪费。

en: Our break-even point is around eight hundred units per month, assuming prices stay where they are.
zh: 我们的盈亏平衡点大约是每月八百件，前提是价格保持不变。

en: I'm not entirely sure the forecast accounts for the seasonal dip in the third quarter.
zh: 我不太确定这个预测有没有考虑到第三季度的季节性下滑。

en: If the supplier raises prices again, we'll have to pass some of that cost to customers.
zh: 如果供应商再次涨价，我们就不得不把一部分成本转嫁给客户。

en: We spent six hundred thousand on research last year and got almost nothing back. Not yet, anyway.
zh: 我们去年在研发上花了六十万，几乎没有什么回报。至少目前还没有。

en: The CEO wants a three-year plan, but the market changes so fast that it feels almost pointless.
zh: 首席执行官想要一个三年计划，但市场变化太快，感觉几乎没什么意义。

en: Either we find a cheaper logistics partner, or we accept that our margins will keep shrinking.
zh: 要么我们找一个更便宜的物流合作伙伴，要么我们就接受利润率继续缩水。

en: Nobody expected the currency to drop that much, and now our overseas revenue looks terrible on paper.
zh: 没人料到汇率会跌那么多，现在我们的海外收入账面上看起来很难看。

en: I'd estimate we need at least two more months to close the gap between budget and actual spending.
zh: 我估计我们至少还需要两个月才能弥合预算与实际支出之间的差距。

en: The bonus pool depends on hitting ninety percent of targets, not a hundred. That's the minimum threshold.
zh: 奖金池取决于是否达到目标的百分之九十，而不是百分之百。那是最低门槛。

en: We're not going to hit the revenue target this year... but we're closer than we were last year.
zh: 我们今年达不到收入目标了……但比去年更接近了。

en: Please double-check the figures for the Asia-Pacific region; something doesn't add up there.
zh: 请再核对一下亚太地区的数据；那边有些数字对不上。

en: If we reinvest half the profits, we grow slower but stay safer. It's a trade-off.
zh: 如果我们把一半利润再投资，增长会慢一些，但会更安全。这是一种取舍。

en: The finance director mentioned a possible shortfall of two million, though she said it's still preliminary.
zh: 财务总监提到可能会有两百万的缺口，不过她说这还只是初步估算。

en: I don't have the exact numbers in front of me, but I think we're slightly over budget on consulting.
zh: 我手头没有确切数字，但我觉得我们在咨询方面略微超支了。

en: Unless something changes, we'll need to borrow money just to cover next month's payroll.
zh: 除非有变化，否则我们下个月连发工资都得借钱。

en: He said the forecast was conservative, but I think he was just being polite. It's optimistic.
zh: 他说这个预测比较保守，但我觉得他只是客气。其实挺乐观的。

en: We've got two options: cut the product line or raise prices. Neither one is popular.
zh: 我们有两个选择：砍掉产品线或者涨价。两个都不受欢迎。

en: About a third of our clients renew annually, and the rest either leave or negotiate a lower rate.
zh: 大约三分之一的客户每年续约，其余的要么离开，要么谈一个更低的价格。

en: I'll need the final budget draft by Thursday, otherwise we can't present it at the Friday meeting.
zh: 我需要在周四之前拿到最终预算草案，否则我们没法在周五的会议上提交。

en: If the pilot program succeeds, we'll roll it out nationwide. If not, we'll quietly shelve it.
zh: 如果试点项目成功，我们将在全国推广。如果不成功，我们就悄悄搁置。

en: The numbers look good on the surface, but I'm worried about the assumptions behind them.
zh: 这些数字表面上看不错，但我担心它们背后的假设。

en: She asked for a five percent increase, but we can only afford two, maybe two and a half.
zh: 她要求涨百分之五，但我们最多只能承受百分之二，也许百分之二点五。

en: We're projecting a loss this quarter, but we expect to break even by early next year.
zh: 我们预计这个季度会亏损，但预计明年年初能实现盈亏平衡。

en: Don't finalize the forecast until accounting confirms the adjusted figures from last month.
zh: 在会计确认上个月的调整数据之前，先不要敲定预测。

en: It's a gamble either way, but doing nothing is also a choice, and it's probably the riskiest one.
zh: 怎么选都是赌，但什么都不做也是一种选择，而且可能是风险最大的那种。

en: Our cash flow improved by about twenty percent, mainly because we delayed several large payments.
zh: 我们的现金流改善了大约百分之二十，主要是因为我们推迟了几笔大额付款。

en: I was told the budget was approved, but I haven't seen anything in writing yet.
zh: 我听说预算已经批准了，但我还没看到任何书面文件。

en: I don't think the reaction will complete before noon unless we increase the temperature, but even then, I'm not entirely sure.
zh: 我认为除非我们提高温度，否则反应不会在中午前完成，但即便如此，我也不能完全确定。

en: The sample might be contaminated, so we should run the test again, but if the results are the same, we'll have to consider other factors.
zh: 样本可能被污染了，所以我们应该重新测试，但如果结果相同，我们就必须考虑其他因素。

en: If the hypothesis is correct, the plants should grow faster under blue light, but they didn't, so maybe the hypothesis is wrong.
zh: 如果假设正确，植物在蓝光下应该生长得更快，但它们没有，所以也许假设是错误的。

en: We observed a 15% increase in yield, but that's not statistically significant given the small sample size.
zh: 我们观察到产量增加了15%，但鉴于样本量小，这在统计上并不显著。

en: The temperature must be kept at exactly 37 degrees Celsius, or the enzymes will denature, and the experiment will fail.
zh: 温度必须保持在37摄氏度，否则酶会变性，实验就会失败。

en: I'm not sure if the solution is acidic or basic; we need to test it with litmus paper.
zh: 我不确定溶液是酸性还是碱性；我们需要用石蕊试纸测试一下。

en: Unless we calibrate the instrument, the measurements will be off by at least 5 units.
zh: 除非我们校准仪器，否则测量值至少会偏差5个单位。

en: The mice in the control group didn't show any adverse effects, but those in the experimental group did, which suggests the drug might be toxic.
zh: 对照组的小鼠没有出现任何不良反应，但实验组的小鼠出现了，这表明药物可能有毒。

en: It's possible that the results are due to chance, but the probability is less than 0.05, so we reject the null hypothesis.
zh: 结果可能是偶然的，但概率小于0.05，所以我们拒绝零假设。

en: We need to replicate the study to confirm the findings, because a single experiment isn't enough to draw a conclusion.
zh: 我们需要重复这项研究来确认发现，因为单一实验不足以得出结论。

en: If we don't control for humidity, the results might be inconsistent, so we should keep it constant at 50%.
zh: 如果我们不控制湿度，结果可能会不一致，所以我们应该将其保持在50%不变。

en: The data doesn't support our initial assumption; in fact, it contradicts it.
zh: 数据不支持我们最初的假设；事实上，它与之矛盾。

en: I doubt that the effect is real; it could be an artifact of the measurement method.
zh: 我怀疑这个效应是真实的；它可能是测量方法的伪影。

en: The chemical should be stored in a dark bottle, otherwise it will degrade rapidly.
zh: 这种化学品应存放在深色瓶中，否则它会迅速降解。

en: We can't conclude that the drug is effective based on this small trial; we need a larger sample size.
zh: 基于这个小规模试验，我们不能断定该药物有效；我们需要更大的样本量。

en: The bacteria grew in the petri dish, but we're not sure if it's the same strain we intended to culture.
zh: 细菌在培养皿中生长了，但我们不确定它是否是我们打算培养的同一菌株。

en: If the voltage exceeds 220 volts, the circuit will overload, so we must install a fuse.
zh: 如果电压超过220伏，电路会过载，所以我们必须安装保险丝。

en: The results were inconclusive, so we cannot accept or reject the hypothesis at this point.
zh: 结果尚无定论，所以此时我们既不能接受也不能拒绝该假设。

en: It might rain tomorrow, but if it doesn't, we'll proceed with the field experiment as planned.
zh: 明天可能下雨，但如果不下的話，我们将按计划进行野外实验。

en: The telescope's lens is slightly scratched, which could distort the images, but we're not certain how much.
zh: 望远镜的镜头有轻微划痕，这可能会使图像失真，但我们不确定程度如何。

en: We found a 2.5% margin of error, which is acceptable for this type of survey.
zh: 我们发现了2.5%的误差范围，这对这类调查来说是可以接受的。

en: The reaction didn't produce the expected color change, so perhaps the catalyst was inactive.
zh: 反应没有产生预期的颜色变化，所以也许催化剂没有活性。

en: If the pH is too low, the protein will precipitate; if it's too high, it will dissolve.
zh: 如果pH值过低，蛋白质会沉淀；如果过高，它会溶解。

en: I'm not convinced that the new method is better; the old one gave similar results with less effort.
zh: 我不相信新方法更好；旧方法用更少的精力给出了类似的结果。

en: The experiment must be conducted in a vacuum, or the presence of air will interfere with the results.
zh: 实验必须在真空中进行，否则空气的存在会干扰结果。

en: We observed a 10-degree drop in temperature, but we don't know what caused it.
zh: 我们观察到温度下降了10度，但我们不知道是什么原因造成的。

en: Unless the sample is properly sealed, it will absorb moisture from the air.
zh: 除非样品妥善密封，否则它会吸收空气中的水分。

en: The hypothesis is plausible, but we need more evidence to support it.
zh: 这个假设是合理的，但我们需要更多证据来支持它。

en: It's unclear whether the effect is reversible or permanent; further studies are needed.
zh: 尚不清楚这种效应是可逆的还是永久性的；需要进一步研究。

en: The machine might be malfunctioning; the readings are fluctuating wildly, so we should check the sensors.
zh: 机器可能发生故障；读数剧烈波动，所以我们应该检查传感器。

en: If we had used a higher concentration, the reaction might have gone to completion, but we didn't, so it didn't.
zh: 如果我们使用了更高的浓度，反应可能会进行到底，但我们没有，所以它没有。

en: The results are consistent with previous studies, but that doesn't prove causation.
zh: 结果与先前的研究一致，但这并不证明因果关系。

en: We can't afford to make any mistakes; even a tiny error could ruin the entire experiment.
zh: 我们不能犯任何错误；即使是一个微小的错误也可能毁掉整个实验。

en: The solution turned blue, which indicates the presence of starch, but we should confirm with another test.
zh: 溶液变蓝，表明存在淀粉，但我们应该用另一个测试来确认。

en: I'm not sure if the laser is aligned properly; the beam seems slightly off-center.
zh: 我不确定激光是否对准；光束似乎稍微偏离中心。

en: If the temperature drops below freezing, the water in the pipes will expand and burst them.
zh: 如果温度降到冰点以下，管道中的水会膨胀并爆裂。

en: The data might be skewed because we only sampled from one location.
zh: 数据可能有偏差，因为我们只从一个地点采样。

en: We need to account for background noise, otherwise the signal will be lost.
zh: 我们需要考虑背景噪声，否则信号会丢失。

en: The chemical reaction is exothermic, so the temperature will rise unless we cool it.
zh: 该化学反应是放热的，所以除非我们冷却它，否则温度会上升。

en: It's not clear whether the effect is due to the drug or the placebo effect.
zh: 尚不清楚这种效应是由于药物还是安慰剂效应。

en: The sample size was too small to detect a significant difference, so we can't rule out a Type II error.
zh: 样本量太小，无法检测到显著差异，所以我们不能排除II型错误。

en: If we don't replicate the experiment, the findings won't be considered reliable.
zh: 如果我们不重复实验，这些发现将不会被认为是可靠的。

en: The instrument readings are inconsistent; sometimes they match, sometimes they don't.
zh: 仪器读数不一致；有时它们匹配，有时不匹配。

en: We might have contaminated the culture, but we won't know for sure until we sequence the DNA.
zh: 我们可能污染了培养物，但直到我们对DNA测序后才能确定。

en: The reaction should take about 30 minutes, but it could take longer if the temperature is lower.
zh: 反应大约需要30分钟，但如果温度较低，可能需要更长时间。

en: I doubt that the results are accurate; there might be a systematic error in the measurement.
zh: 我怀疑结果是否准确；测量中可能存在系统误差。

en: If the hypothesis is false, then the observed effect must be due to some other variable.
zh: 如果假设是错误的，那么观察到的效应必定是由于其他变量。

en: The plants didn't grow as expected; maybe they need more sunlight or nutrients.
zh: 植物没有按预期生长；也许它们需要更多的阳光或营养。

en: We must ensure that the control group is treated identically to the experimental group, except for the variable being tested.
zh: 我们必须确保对照组与实验组除被测试的变量外接受相同的处理。

en: The results are promising, but we can't draw any firm conclusions until we've repeated the study.
zh: 结果很有希望，但在重复研究之前，我们不能得出任何确定的结论。

en: The survey says 62 percent of commuters would switch to cycling if protected lanes existed, but that doesn't mean they actually will.
zh: 调查显示，如果存在受保护的自行车道，62%的通勤者会改骑自行车，但这并不意味着他们真的会这么做。

en: We found a strong correlation between ice cream sales and drowning rates, yet neither causes the other; hot weather drives both.
zh: 我们发现冰淇淋销量和溺水率之间存在很强的相关性，但两者并不互为因果；炎热的天气同时推动了这两者。

en: Only 8 percent of participants reported side effects, though the study didn't track symptoms for more than two weeks.
zh: 只有8%的参与者报告了副作用，不过这项研究追踪症状的时间没有超过两周。

en: If the sample size had been larger, maybe the difference between the two groups would have reached significance.
zh: 如果样本量更大一些，也许两组之间的差异就会达到显著水平。

en: Roughly three out of ten customers who received the discount came back within a month, compared with two out of ten who didn't.
zh: 收到折扣的顾客中大约有十分之三在一个月内再次光顾，而没收到折扣的顾客中只有十分之二。

en: The headline claimed a 40 percent drop in crime, but it was based on a single precinct and just six months of data.
zh: 标题声称犯罪率下降了40%，但这是基于一个警区和仅仅六个月的数据。

en: I'm not saying the policy caused the decline; I'm only pointing out that the decline happened after the policy.
zh: 我不是说这项政策导致了下降；我只是指出下降发生在政策之后。

en: About 15 percent of the seeds never germinated, which is lower than the 25 percent we saw last season.
zh: 大约15%的种子没有发芽，这比我们上季度看到的25%要低。

en: Unless we account for age and income, the correlation between coffee and longevity might be misleading.
zh: 除非我们把年龄和收入考虑进去，否则咖啡与长寿之间的相关性可能会产生误导。

en: Nearly half the respondents said they felt worse after the change, while the other half reported no difference at all.
zh: 近一半的受访者表示改变后感觉更糟，而另一半则报告完全没有差别。

en: The vaccine reduced hospitalizations by 70 percent in the trial, but real-world effectiveness could be somewhat lower.
zh: 该疫苗在试验中将住院率降低了70%，但真实世界的有效性可能会略低一些。

en: It's possible that the 12 percent increase in sales was due to the holiday, not the ad campaign.
zh: 销售额增长12%有可能是假日造成的，而不是广告活动。

en: Two-thirds of the volunteers finished the program, and among those who dropped out, most cited lack of time.
zh: 三分之二的志愿者完成了项目，而在退出的人中，大多数人提到缺少时间。

en: If you look at the raw numbers instead of percentages, the gap between the groups is actually quite small.
zh: 如果你看原始数字而不是百分比，两组之间的差距其实相当小。

en: The report estimates that 1 in 5 households will move within five years, though that figure varies by region.
zh: 报告估计五分之一家庭将在五年内搬家，不过这一数字因地区而异。

en: We can't conclude that the training program boosted productivity; too many other factors changed at the same time.
zh: 我们不能断定培训项目提高了生产率；同时有太多其他因素发生了变化。

en: Almost 90 percent of the plastic in the sample was recyclable, but only about 30 percent actually gets recycled.
zh: 样本中近90%的塑料是可回收的，但实际被回收的只有大约30%。

en: The difference between 55 and 60 percent may not be meaningful, given the margin of error.
zh: 考虑到误差范围，55%和60%之间的差异可能没有实际意义。

en: She said the risk was low, but she didn't specify whether that meant 1 percent or 10 percent.
zh: 她说风险很低，但没有说明那是1%还是10%。

en: If the trend continues, we could see a 20 percent decline by 2030, but that's a big if.
zh: 如果这一趋势持续下去，到2030年我们可能会看到20%的下降，但这是个很大的假设。

en: Only a third of the employees agreed with the new policy, and another third were undecided.
zh: 只有三分之一的员工同意新政策，另外三分之一尚未决定。

en: The study linked moderate exercise to a 25 percent lower risk of heart disease, but it couldn't prove cause and effect.
zh: 该研究将适度运动与心脏病风险降低25%联系起来，但无法证明因果关系。

en: I doubt the 5 percent uptick means much; it's within the normal range of fluctuation.
zh: 我怀疑这5%的小幅上升没有多大意义；它在正常波动范围内。

en: Nearly 40 percent of the city's buses were late, yet the transit agency reported an on-time rate of 85 percent.
zh: 该市近40%的公交车晚点，但交通机构报告的准点率却是85%。

en: The sales figures rose by 18 percent, but after adjusting for inflation, the real increase was only 3 percent.
zh: 销售数字上升了18%，但经通胀调整后，实际增长只有3%。

en: Unless the dropout rate falls below 10 percent, the results won't be considered reliable.
zh: 除非退出率降到10%以下，否则结果不会被认为是可靠的。

en: About 7 in 10 people said they'd pay more for eco-friendly packaging, but far fewer actually do.
zh: 大约十分之七的人表示愿意为环保包装多付钱，但实际这样做的人要少得多。

en: The correlation between the two variables was 0.6, which suggests a moderate relationship, not a perfect one.
zh: 这两个变量之间的相关性为0.6，这表明存在中等程度的关系，而非完美关系。

en: I'm not convinced that the 15 percent improvement came from the new software; the team also got more staff.
zh: 我不相信15%的改善来自新软件；团队还增加了人手。

en: If we exclude the outliers, the average drops from 42 to 38, which changes the story quite a bit.
zh: 如果我们排除异常值，平均值从42降到38，这就在很大程度上改变了结论。

en: Only 22 percent of the patients in the control group improved, compared with 48 percent in the treatment group.
zh: 对照组中只有22%的患者有所改善，而治疗组中为48%。

en: The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 4 percent, so the race is still too close to call.
zh: 该民调的误差范围为正负4个百分点，因此选情仍然胶着，难以预测。

en: It's unclear whether the 10 percent reduction in emissions was due to the new law or the mild winter.
zh: 排放量减少10%是因为新法律还是因为暖冬，目前尚不清楚。

en: Roughly 60 percent of the survey respondents were women, which may have skewed the results.
zh: 大约60%的调查受访者是女性，这可能使结果出现偏差。

en: The company claims its product is 99 percent effective, but that's based on a very specific lab test.
zh: 该公司声称其产品99%有效，但这是基于一项非常特定的实验室测试。

en: If the effect size is really that small, we'd need thousands of participants to detect it.
zh: 如果效应量真的那么小，我们需要数千名参与者才能检测到它。

en: Nearly one in four young adults reported feeling lonely often, which is higher than the rate among older adults.
zh: 近四分之一的年轻人报告经常感到孤独，这比老年人的比例要高。

en: The data shows a 30 percent increase in traffic accidents, but the city also added more cars to the road.
zh: 数据显示交通事故增加了30%，但该市道路上的汽车也增多了。

en: I wouldn't say the drug is unsafe; I'd say the evidence for its safety is not yet strong enough.
zh: 我不会说这种药不安全；我会说其安全性的证据还不够充分。

en: About half the class passed the exam, and among those who failed, most missed the same three questions.
zh: 大约一半的班级通过了考试，而在不及格的人中，大多数人错过了同样的三道题。

en: The 2 percent difference between the candidates is well within the poll's margin of error.
zh: 两位候选人之间2%的差距完全在民调的误差范围内。

en: Unless we control for socioeconomic status, the link between diet and health may be confounded.
zh: 除非我们控制社会经济地位，否则饮食与健康之间的联系可能会受到混杂因素的影响。

en: Only 5 out of 100 participants experienced the side effect, but that was enough to pause the trial.
zh: 100名参与者中只有5人出现了副作用，但这已足以暂停试验。

en: If the sample had been random, maybe the 12 percent difference would hold up, but it wasn't.
zh: 如果样本是随机的，也许12%的差异会站得住脚，但事实并非如此。

en: The report says 80 percent of the budget went to salaries, leaving little for equipment and training.
zh: 报告称80%的预算用于工资，留给设备和培训的很少。

en: I think the 50 percent figure is exaggerated; it probably includes people who only tried it once.
zh: 我认为50%这个数字被夸大了；它可能包括了只尝试过一次的人。

en: Almost 70 percent of the land is used for agriculture, yet the country still imports most of its food.
zh: 近70%的土地用于农业，但该国仍进口大部分粮食。

en: The correlation doesn't prove causation, especially when the data comes from a single year.
zh: 相关性并不能证明因果关系，尤其是当数据仅来自一年时。

en: If the response rate is only 20 percent, the survey results may not represent the whole population.
zh: 如果回复率只有20%，调查结果可能无法代表整个人群。

en: About 1 in 3 adults said they read no books last year, which is up from 1 in 4 a decade ago.
zh: 大约三分之一的成年人表示去年没有读过书，这比十年前的 四分之一有所上升。

en: I don't think the exam was unfair, but I'm not entirely sure everyone had the same time.
zh: 我不认为考试不公平，但我不完全确定每个人都有相同的时间。

en: If you review just twenty minutes a day, you'll probably remember more than if you cram for three hours.
zh: 如果你每天只复习二十分钟，你可能会比突击三个小时记得更多。

en: She said the lecture was boring, but I found it quite interesting, especially the part about volcanoes.
zh: 她说讲座很无聊，但我觉得挺有趣的，尤其是关于火山的部分。

en: Unless the library extends its hours, I won't be able to finish this project by Friday.
zh: 除非图书馆延长开放时间，否则我无法在周五前完成这个项目。

en: He didn't fail because he was lazy; he failed because he missed almost two weeks of class.
zh: 他失败不是因为他懒；他失败是因为他缺了将近两周的课。

en: Could you explain that again? I didn't catch the part about the formula for calculating the area.
zh: 你能再解释一遍吗？我没听清关于计算面积公式的部分。

en: The teacher said we could choose either topic, but not both, and the deadline is next Monday.
zh: 老师说我们可以选择任何一个题目，但不能两个都选，截止日期是下周一。

en: I'm not sure if the history class covers the twentieth century, or if we need to read the extra chapter.
zh: 我不确定历史课是否涵盖二十世纪，或者我们是否需要阅读额外章节。

en: If I had known the test was open-book, I wouldn't have spent all night memorizing dates.
zh: 如果我知道考试是开卷的，我就不会花一整夜背日期了。

en: She's not only a great student but also a patient tutor, though she rarely has free time.
zh: 她不仅是个优秀的学生，还是个耐心的导师，尽管她很少有空闲时间。

en: The assignment asks for at least five sources, but no more than ten, and they must be recent.
zh: 作业要求至少五个来源，但不超过十个，而且必须是近期的。

en: I don't understand why the professor marked my answer wrong when the textbook says the opposite.
zh: 我不明白为什么教授把我的答案判错了，而教科书上说的相反。

en: Unless you practice speaking every day, you won't improve your pronunciation much.
zh: 除非你每天练习口语，否则你的发音不会有多大进步。

en: He might have passed the course if he had turned in the final essay on time.
zh: 如果他按时交了期末论文，他可能已经通过这门课了。

en: The lab report needs to be between eight and twelve pages, double-spaced, with at least three graphs.
zh: 实验报告需要在八到十二页之间，双倍行距，至少有三张图表。

en: I'm not saying the book is bad; I'm just saying it's not the best introduction to the subject.
zh: 我不是说这本书不好；我只是说它不是该学科最好的入门书。

en: If the group project falls apart, we'll have to ask the teacher for an extension.
zh: 如果小组项目失败了，我们将不得不向老师请求延期。

en: She didn't understand the instructions, so she asked a classmate, but he wasn't sure either.
zh: 她没看懂说明，所以她问了同学，但他也不确定。

en: You should review your notes within twenty-four hours, or you'll forget nearly half of what you learned.
zh: 你应该在二十四小时内复习笔记，否则你会忘记所学内容的近一半。

en: The online course is self-paced, but you must complete all ten modules before the end of the semester.
zh: 在线课程是自定进度的，但你必须在学期结束前完成所有十个模块。

en: I can't decide whether to take the advanced math class or the statistics course next term.
zh: 我无法决定下学期是选高级数学课还是统计学课程。

en: If you don't cite your sources, you could be accused of plagiarism, even accidentally.
zh: 如果你不引用来源，你可能会被指控剽窃，即使是无意中。

en: He said he would help me study, but he canceled at the last minute because he had to work.
zh: 他说他会帮我学习，但他在最后一刻取消了，因为他必须工作。

en: The professor's feedback was helpful, though I wish she had given more specific examples.
zh: 教授的反馈很有帮助，尽管我希望她给了更具体的例子。

en: Unless the school provides more computers, some students won't be able to finish the coding assignment.
zh: 除非学校提供更多电脑，否则一些学生将无法完成编程作业。

en: I'm not convinced that group work is always better; sometimes it's just more stressful.
zh: 我不相信小组合作总是更好；有时它只是压力更大。

en: She might not have realized that the deadline was moved to Wednesday instead of Friday.
zh: 她可能没有意识到截止日期改到了周三而不是周五。

en: The scholarship covers tuition and books, but not housing or meals, which cost about eight thousand a year.
zh: 奖学金涵盖学费和书本费，但不包括住宿或餐饮，这些每年大约花费八千。

en: If the test is curved, then a seventy-five might actually be a decent grade.
zh: 如果考试是按曲线评分，那么七十五分实际上可能是个不错的成绩。

en: He didn't take notes during the video, so he had to watch it again to answer the questions.
zh: 他在看视频时没有做笔记，所以他不得不重新看一遍来回答问题。

en: I wonder if the teacher will accept late homework, or if she'll deduct points for every day.
zh: 我想知道老师是否会接受迟交的作业，或者她是否会每天扣分。

en: The study group meets every Tuesday and Thursday, but we sometimes skip if everyone is busy.
zh: 学习小组每周二和周四见面，但如果大家都很忙，我们有时会跳过。

en: You can't learn a language just by reading; you have to practice speaking and listening too.
zh: 你不能只通过阅读来学习一门语言；你也必须练习口语和听力。

en: She was absent for three days, so she missed the pop quiz and the review session.
zh: 她缺席了三天，所以她错过了随堂测验和复习课。

en: If I don't understand a concept, I usually watch a video or ask a friend for help.
zh: 如果我不理解一个概念，我通常会看视频或向朋友求助。

en: The final exam will cover chapters one through five, but not chapter six, according to the syllabus.
zh: 根据教学大纲，期末考试将涵盖第一到第五章，但不包括第六章。

en: He's not the fastest reader, but he remembers almost everything he reads.
zh: 他不是读书最快的人，但他几乎记得他读过的所有内容。

en: Unless you save your work frequently, you might lose everything if the computer crashes.
zh: 除非你经常保存工作，否则如果电脑崩溃，你可能会丢失一切。

en: I'm not sure whether the class starts at nine or nine-thirty, so I'll check the schedule.
zh: 我不确定课程是九点还是九点半开始，所以我查一下时间表。

en: The teacher said we could use one index card, but no calculators, on the midterm.
zh: 老师说期中考试我们可以用一张索引卡，但不能用计算器。

en: She didn't do well on the first test, but she improved a lot on the second one.
zh: 她第一次考试没考好，但第二次进步了很多。

en: If you want to improve your writing, you should read more and write every day.
zh: 如果你想提高写作，你应该多读并且每天写。

en: The library has only three copies of the textbook, so you might not get one.
zh: 图书馆只有三本教科书，所以你可能拿不到。

en: I can't believe the semester is almost over; it feels like it just started.
zh: 我简直不敢相信这个学期快结束了；感觉就像刚开始一样。

en: He might have misunderstood the assignment, because he wrote about the wrong topic.
zh: 他可能误解了作业，因为他写错了题目。

en: The professor said the exam would be difficult, but not impossible if we study the review sheet.
zh: 教授说考试会很难，但如果我们学习复习表，并非不可能。

en: I don't have time to join a study group, but I might form one with just two friends.
zh: 我没有时间加入学习小组，但我可能会和两个朋友组成一个。

en: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we'll have class outside instead of in the classroom.
zh: 如果明天天气好，我们将在户外上课，而不是在教室里。

en: She didn't raise her hand because she wasn't sure of the answer, and she didn't want to be wrong.
zh: 她没有举手，因为她不确定答案，而且她不想出错。

en: The online quiz is timed, so you have only fifteen minutes to answer ten questions.
zh: 在线测验是计时的，所以你只有十五分钟回答十个问题。

en: I keep telling myself I'll start studying at eight, but somehow it's always nine-thirty before I open the book.
zh: 我一直告诉自己八点就开始学习，但不知怎么的，等我打开书的时候总是已经九点半了。

en: If you don't set a specific time for the gym, you probably won't go at all.
zh: 如果你不给去健身房设定一个具体时间，你很可能根本就不会去。

en: She wanted to build a reading habit, so she started with just five pages a night instead of a whole chapter.
zh: 她想养成阅读的习惯，所以一开始每晚只读五页，而不是整整一章。

en: I'm not lazy, I just can't seem to make myself start until the deadline is uncomfortably close.
zh: 我不是懒，我只是似乎非要等到截止日期近得让人难受时才能逼自己开始。

en: Maybe if we put the snacks on the top shelf, we'd stop mindlessly eating while watching TV.
zh: 也许如果我们把零食放到最上层架子上，就不会在看电视时无意识地吃了。

en: He tried waking up at five for a week, but he was so exhausted by Thursday that he slept until noon on Saturday.
zh: 他试着连续一周五点起床，但到周四他就累得不行，周六一直睡到中午。

en: The trick isn't motivation, it's making the first step so small that you can't say no.
zh: 诀窍不是动力，而是把第一步变得小到你无法拒绝。

en: I'll write for twenty minutes after lunch, unless a meeting runs over, in which case I'll do it before dinner.
zh: 我会在午饭后写二十分钟，除非会议超时，那样的话我就在晚饭前写。

en: Do you ever feel like you spend more time planning to work than actually working?
zh: 你有没有觉得自己花在计划工作上的时间比实际工作还多？

en: She left her running shoes by the door so she wouldn't have an excuse to skip her morning jog.
zh: 她把跑鞋放在门口，这样就没有借口跳过晨跑了。

en: I used to scroll on my phone for an hour before bed, but now I leave it charging in the kitchen.
zh: 我以前睡前会刷一个小时手机，但现在我把手机放在厨房充电。

en: If you miss one day, don't miss two—that's the rule that keeps the habit alive.
zh: 如果漏掉一天，不要漏掉第二天——这是让习惯保持下去的规则。

en: He said he'd pay me back on Friday, but it's already Tuesday and I haven't heard a word.
zh: 他说周五还我钱，但现在已经周二了，我一个字都没听到。

en: We could start with ten minutes of tidying each evening, or we could just wait for the mess to become unbearable.
zh: 我们可以每晚先整理十分钟，或者干脆等乱到无法忍受再说。

en: I don't always floss, but I'm trying to attach it to brushing so I don't forget.
zh: 我不是每天都用牙线，但我试着把它和刷牙绑在一起，这样就不会忘。

en: The app sends a reminder at seven, and if I ignore it, it buzzes again at seven-fifteen.
zh: 这个应用七点发提醒，如果我忽略它，七点十五分会再响一次。

en: She wasn't procrastinating on purpose; she just kept waiting for the perfect moment that never came.
zh: 她不是故意拖延，她只是一直在等一个永远不会到来的完美时刻。

en: Instead of saying I'll eat healthier, I decided to add one vegetable to every dinner.
zh: 与其说我要吃得更健康，我决定每顿晚饭加一种蔬菜。

en: If I don't write down what I need to do, I'll spend the whole day reacting to other people's requests.
zh: 如果我不写下需要做的事，我就会一整天都在回应别人的请求。

en: He kept a calendar and marked an X for every day he practiced, and soon he didn't want to break the chain.
zh: 他弄了一个日历，每练习一天就画一个X，很快他就不想打断这个链条了。

en: I can't study in a messy room, but cleaning becomes its own way of avoiding studying.
zh: 我在乱糟糟的房间里没法学习，但打扫本身又成了一种逃避学习的方式。

en: Maybe we should set a timer for thirty minutes and just see how much we get done.
zh: 也许我们应该设一个三十分钟的计时器，看看能完成多少。

en: She promised herself she'd only check email twice a day, but by noon she'd already checked it eight times.
zh: 她向自己保证每天只查两次邮件，但到中午她已经查了八次。

en: If the task feels too big, break it into pieces so small they seem almost silly.
zh: 如果任务感觉太大，就把它拆成小到几乎显得可笑的碎片。

en: I'm not sure I'll ever enjoy running, but I do like how I feel afterward.
zh: 我不确定自己会不会喜欢跑步，但我确实喜欢跑完后的感觉。

en: He used to say he worked best under pressure, until he realized he was just always under pressure.
zh: 他以前常说自己在压力下工作得最好，直到他意识到自己只是一直处在压力下。

en: We agreed to meet at six, but if traffic is bad, we might not get there until six-forty-five.
zh: 我们约好六点见面，但如果堵车，我们可能要到六点四十五才能到。

en: I'll meditate for five minutes after I pour my morning coffee, before I check my phone.
zh: 我会在倒完早咖啡后、看手机前冥想五分钟。

en: She didn't want to become a morning person; she just wanted twenty quiet minutes before the kids woke up.
zh: 她并不想成为早起的人，她只是想在孩子们醒来前有二十安静分钟。

en: If you keep waiting until you feel like it, you'll be waiting forever.
zh: 如果你一直等到有感觉才做，你会永远等下去。

en: I put my guitar on a stand in the living room, and now I pick it up almost every day.
zh: 我把吉他放在客厅的架子上，现在几乎每天都拿起来弹。

en: He said he'd cut back on coffee, but he still drinks three cups before lunch.
zh: 他说要少喝咖啡，但午饭前他还是喝三杯。

en: Maybe the problem isn't discipline; maybe the habit is just too hard to do in the first place.
zh: 也许问题不是自律；也许这个习惯本身一开始就太难做了。

en: We can either meal-prep on Sunday or spend forty dollars a week on takeout.
zh: 我们要么周日备餐，要么每周花四十美元点外卖。

en: I don't always feel like journaling, but I write one sentence even on days I don't want to.
zh: 我不是总想写日记，但即使不想写，我也会写一句话。

en: She set her alarm for six-thirty, but she hit snooze four times and got up at seven-ten.
zh: 她把闹钟设在六点半，但她按了四次贪睡，七点十分才起床。

en: If I keep my phone in the other room, I read at least ten pages before I fall asleep.
zh: 如果我把手机放在另一个房间，我睡前至少能读十页。

en: He wasn't avoiding the project; he was just waiting until he had a clear idea of what to do.
zh: 他不是在逃避这个项目；他只是在等自己清楚知道该做什么。

en: The hardest part is starting, so I tell myself I'll only do two minutes.
zh: 最难的部分是开始，所以我告诉自己只做两分钟。

en: I used to think I needed a whole hour to exercise, but a fifteen-minute walk still counts.
zh: 我以前觉得需要整整一小时才能锻炼，但十五分钟的散步也算数。

en: If you don't feel like cooking, that's fine—just don't order the largest pizza on the menu.
zh: 如果你不想做饭，没关系——只是别点菜单上最大的披萨。

en: She kept a water bottle on her desk and drank two liters without even noticing.
zh: 她在桌上放了一个水瓶，不知不觉就喝了两升。

en: I'm not saying you have to wake up at five; I'm saying you need a routine you can actually keep.
zh: 我不是说你必须五点起床；我是说你需要一个真正能坚持的日常安排。

en: Maybe we can study together for an hour, unless you'd rather work alone.
zh: 也许我们可以一起学习一小时，除非你更想独自工作。

en: He wanted to stop biting his nails, so he kept a fidget toy in his pocket.
zh: 他想改掉咬指甲的习惯，所以口袋里放了一个解压玩具。

en: I'll answer emails at nine and three, but if something urgent comes in, I'll handle it right away.
zh: 我会在九点和三点回邮件，但如果有紧急的事进来，我会立刻处理。

en: She didn't finish the whole book, but she read for twenty minutes every night for a month.
zh: 她没有读完整本书，但她一个月里每晚都读了二十分钟。

en: If the gym is too far, you won't go—so pick something within a ten-minute walk.
zh: 如果健身房太远，你就不会去——所以选一个步行十分钟以内的地方。

en: I can't believe I waited until the night before to write three thousand words.
zh: 我真不敢相信我拖到前一天晚上才写三千字。

en: We could keep talking about the plan, or we could just try it for one week and see.
zh: 我们可以继续讨论计划，或者干脆试一个星期看看。

en: Honestly, I'm not sure the plan will work, but if we don't try it now, we might never get another chance.
zh: 说实话，我不确定这个计划会成功，但如果我们现在不试，可能就再也没有机会了。

en: The rain stopped about an hour ago, so we can probably walk to the station instead of taking a taxi.
zh: 雨大约一小时前停了，所以我们大概可以走去车站，不用打车。

en: She said she'd call back before noon, and it's already half past eleven, so I'm getting a little worried.
zh: 她说中午前会回电话，现在已经十一点半了，所以我有点担心。

en: Don't touch that wire...
zh: 别碰那根电线……

en: If you finish your homework before dinner, you can watch one episode, but only one.
zh: 如果你在晚饭前写完作业，可以看一集，但只能看一集。

en: We waited almost forty minutes for the bus, and then three of them arrived at the same time.
zh: 我们等公交车等了将近四十分钟，然后三辆同时到了。

en: I know it sounds strange, but I actually prefer cold coffee to hot coffee in the summer.
zh: 我知道这听起来很奇怪，但夏天我其实更喜欢冷咖啡而不是热咖啡。

en: He didn't say he was angry; he just went quiet and stared out the window for a while.
zh: 他没说他生气了；他只是沉默下来，盯着窗外看了一会儿。

en: Could you speak a little slower, please? I understood the first part, but the rest went too fast.
zh: 你能说慢一点吗？第一部分我听懂了，但后面太快了。

en: The meeting might end early, depending on whether the manager has another appointment.
zh: 会议可能会提前结束，这取决于经理是否还有另一个约会。

en: Two kilos of apples...
zh: 两公斤苹果……

en: Although the instructions looked simple, hardly anyone managed to assemble the shelf correctly on the first try.
zh: 虽然说明书看起来很简单，但几乎没有人第一次就能把架子正确组装好。

en: My grandmother always says that a quiet morning and a good cup of tea can fix almost anything.
zh: 我奶奶总说，一个安静的早晨和一杯好茶几乎能解决任何事。

en: Unless the weather improves, we'll have to move the picnic indoors, which nobody is excited about.
zh: 除非天气好转，否则我们只能把野餐改到室内，没人对此感到兴奋。

en: Turn left at the second light, not the first one, and you'll see the library on your right.
zh: 在第二个红绿灯左转，不是第一个，然后你会看到图书馆在你右边。

en: I've been trying to learn this song for weeks, but the middle section still trips me up every time.
zh: 这首歌我学了好几个星期，但中间那段每次还是会把我卡住。

en: It's not that I dislike the idea; it's just that we don't have enough time or money right now.
zh: 不是我不喜欢这个主意；只是我们现在既没有足够的时间，也没有足够的钱。

en: Fifteen students signed up for the workshop, but only nine showed up on Saturday morning.
zh: 有十五名学生报名参加了工作坊，但周六早上只来了九个人。

en: He talks as if he knows everything, yet he never actually listens when someone corrects him.
zh: 他说话的样子好像什么都懂，但别人纠正他时，他从来不听。

en: Before you leave...
zh: 在你离开之前……

en: The soup tastes a bit bland, so maybe add some salt, but be careful not to overdo it.
zh: 这汤味道有点淡，也许加点盐，但小心别加太多。

en: Even though she practiced every day, she still felt nervous when she stepped onto the stage.
zh: 尽管她每天都练习，但走上舞台时还是感到紧张。

en: We could either take the train tonight or wait until tomorrow morning; it depends on you.
zh: 我们要么今晚坐火车，要么等到明天早上；这取决于你。

en: The package should arrive within three to five business days, unless there's a delay at customs.
zh: 包裹应该在三到五个工作日内到达，除非海关有延误。

en: I didn't mean to interrupt you, but your phone has been buzzing for the last ten minutes.
zh: 我不是有意打断你，但你的手机在过去十分钟里一直在响。

en: About three hundred people...
zh: 大约三百人……

en: If I had known you were coming, I would have baked something, but the fridge is almost empty.
zh: 如果我知道你要来，我就会烤点东西，但冰箱几乎是空的。

en: He promised to fix the leak on Tuesday, and when he didn't show up, we called someone else.
zh: 他答应周二来修漏水，结果他没来，我们就叫了别人。

en: The movie wasn't as good as the book, though the ending was surprisingly well done.
zh: 这部电影不如书好看，不过结局出乎意料地拍得不错。

en: You should double-check the address before mailing the letter, or it might get returned.
zh: 寄信之前你应该再核对一下地址，否则可能会被退回来。

en: Half a liter of milk...
zh: 半升牛奶……

en: Whenever I feel overwhelmed, I take a short walk around the block and come back with a clearer head.
zh: 每当我感到不堪重负时，我就绕着街区散一会儿步，回来时头脑就清楚多了。

en: She didn't answer my question directly, which made me wonder if she even knew the truth.
zh: 她没有直接回答我的问题，这让我怀疑她是否知道真相。

en: The bakery opens at seven, but if you get there after nine, most of the good bread is gone.
zh: 面包店七点开门，但如果你九点以后到，大部分好吃的面包都没了。

en: I can lend you my umbrella, but I'll need it back before Friday because I'm traveling.
zh: 我可以把伞借给你，但周五之前我得拿回来，因为我要出门。

en: It was so cold that the pond froze overnight, and the kids couldn't wait to skate on it.
zh: 天太冷了，池塘一夜之间结了冰，孩子们迫不及待地想去滑冰。

en: Although he apologized, I still felt hurt, and I told him I needed some time alone.
zh: 虽然他道歉了，但我还是觉得受伤，我告诉他我需要一些独处的时间。

en: The instructions say to press the green button twice, but nothing happens when I do that.
zh: 说明书上说按两次绿色按钮，但我按了之后什么反应都没有。

en: We've lived in this neighborhood for twelve years, and we still don't know all our neighbors.
zh: 我们在这个社区住了十二年，但还是不认识所有的邻居。

en: If the noise doesn't stop by midnight, I'm going to call the building manager, not the police.
zh: 如果噪音到半夜还不停，我就打给物业经理，而不是报警。

en: He speaks three languages fluently, yet he's too shy to order food in any of them at a restaurant.
zh: 他能流利地说三种语言，但在餐馆里却害羞得不敢用任何一种点菜。

en: The path was steeper than we expected, so we stopped halfway up to catch our breath.
zh: 那条路比我们预想的陡，所以我们爬到一半就停下来喘口气。

en: I'm not saying you're wrong, but have you considered what might happen if the opposite is true?
zh: 我不是说你错了，但你有没有想过，如果反过来才是真的，会怎么样？

en: Whenever the phone rings after ten at night, my heart races a little, even when it's just a wrong number.
zh: 每当晚上十点以后电话响起，我的心就会跳得快一点，即使只是打错的号码。

en: You can borrow the car, as long as you fill the tank before you bring it back.
zh: 你可以借用这辆车，只要你开回来之前把油加满。

en: The test had thirty questions, but we were only given twenty minutes to finish all of them.
zh: 考试有三十道题，但只给了我们二十分钟来完成全部。

en: He kept nodding during the whole presentation, but afterward he couldn't remember a single point.
zh: 整个演讲过程中他一直在点头，但结束后他一个要点都记不起来。

en: If we don't listen to the quietest voices in the room, we'll keep making the same mistakes.
zh: 如果我们不听房间里最安静的声音，就会一直犯同样的错误。

en: She said the budget was 2 million, but the actual shortfall is closer to 4.5 million.
zh: 她说预算是两百万，但实际缺口接近四百五十万。

en: I'm not saying the plan is bad; I'm just not sure it'll work without more volunteers.
zh: 我不是说这个计划不好；我只是不确定没有更多志愿者它能不能行得通。

en: Unless the city council approves the permit by Friday, we'll have to postpone the cleanup.
zh: 除非市议会在周五前批准许可，否则我们只能推迟清理活动。

en: He kept promising change, yet nothing changed for the families on our street.
zh: 他一直在承诺改变，可我们这条街上的家庭什么也没变。

en: We need 30 chairs, 12 tables, and at least 5 coolers of water for the event.
zh: 活动需要三十把椅子、十二张桌子和至少五箱水。

en: It might rain, so bring the tents—but don't set them up until I give the word.
zh: 可能会下雨，所以把帐篷带上——但在我发话之前不要搭起来。

en: The mayor didn't show up, and honestly, I doubt she ever intended to.
zh: 市长没有露面，说实话，我怀疑她压根就没打算来。

en: If you want people to follow you, you have to show up when it's inconvenient.
zh: 如果你想让人们追随你，就得在不方便的时候也到场。

en: We've knocked on 87 doors this week, but only 14 people signed up.
zh: 这周我们敲了八十七家门，但只有十四个人报名。

en: The grant covers supplies, not salaries, so we still need to raise about 8,000.
zh: 这笔拨款覆盖物资，不包括工资，所以我们还需要筹集大约八千。

en: I can't promise we'll win this vote, but I can promise we'll be heard.
zh: 我不能保证我们会赢得这次投票，但我能保证我们的声音会被听到。

en: Either we compromise on the wording, or the whole resolution dies in committee.
zh: 要么我们在措辞上妥协，要么整个决议就死在委员会里。

en: She's the kind of leader who gives credit away and takes the blame herself.
zh: 她是那种把功劳让给别人、把责任揽到自己身上的领导者。

en: Don't just talk about the problem—bring one concrete solution to the next meeting.
zh: 不要只是谈论问题——下次会议带一个具体的解决方案来。

en: The neighborhood watch started with 3 people; now it's over 60.
zh: 邻里守望刚开始只有三个人；现在超过六十个了。

en: We lost the first vote by 2, but we gained 9 new allies since then.
zh: 第一次投票我们以两票之差输了，但从那以后我们多了九个新盟友。

en: If they won't come to the table, we'll build our own table.
zh: 如果他们不肯坐到谈判桌前，我们就自己搭一张桌子。

en: He didn't raise his voice once, and that's exactly why people listened.
zh: 他一次也没有提高嗓门，而这正是人们愿意听的原因。

en: The survey shows 68 percent support, but the margin of error is 5 points.
zh: 调查显示百分之六十八的支持率，但误差范围是五个百分点。

en: I'm not convinced the new policy will help renters, but I'm willing to be proven wrong.
zh: 我不相信新政策会帮助租房者，但我愿意被证明是错的。

en: We can't do everything, but we can do something—and something is not nothing.
zh: 我们做不了所有事，但我们可以做点事——而做点事并不是什么都不做。

en: She asked for 15 minutes; they gave her 3, and she still made her case.
zh: 她要求十五分钟；他们只给了三分钟，她仍然把理由讲清楚了。

en: When the power went out, nobody panicked—they just started knocking on doors.
zh: 停电的时候，没有人惊慌——他们只是开始挨家挨户敲门。

en: If we keep meeting like this without a clear goal, people will stop coming.
zh: 如果我们继续这样没有明确目标地开会，人们就不会再来了。

en: The petition needs 500 signatures; we have 320, and the deadline is Monday.
zh: 请愿书需要五百个签名；我们有三百二十个，截止日期是周一。

en: He talks a big game, but when it's time to clean up, he disappears.
zh: 他说得天花乱坠，但到了该清理的时候，他就不见了。

en: I'd rather have a small team that shows up than a big one that doesn't.
zh: 我宁愿要一个到场的小团队，也不要一个不到场的大团队。

en: The library will close unless 200 people attend the hearing on Thursday.
zh: 除非有两百人参加周四的听证会，否则图书馆将关闭。

en: We didn't get the grant, but we did get the park cleaned up.
zh: 我们没拿到拨款，但我们确实把公园清理干净了。

en: She's not the loudest person here, but she's the one who gets things done.
zh: 她不是这里嗓门最大的人，但她是能把事情办成的人。

en: If you can give 2 hours a month, that's 24 hours a year—enough to matter.
zh: 如果你每月能拿出两小时，一年就是二十四小时——足以起作用。

en: The council meeting ran until 11:40, and still no decision was made.
zh: 议会会议一直开到十一点四十，仍然没有做出决定。

en: I'm not here to blame anyone; I'm here to fix the leak before it floods the basement.
zh: 我不是来责怪任何人的；我是来在漏水淹了地下室之前把它修好的。

en: They promised 10 new buses, but only 4 arrived, and 2 of those don't run.
zh: 他们承诺十辆新公交车，但只到了四辆，其中两辆还开不了。

en: We can disagree about the method, as long as we agree on the goal.
zh: 我们可以对方法有分歧，只要我们在目标上一致。

en: If the flyer doesn't have a phone number, people won't call—they'll just forget.
zh: 如果传单上没有电话号码，人们就不会打——他们只会忘记。

en: He didn't just donate money; he showed up every Saturday for a year.
zh: 他不仅捐了钱；他还整整一年每个周六都到场。

en: The block party cost 1,200, and we raised 1,450, so we have a little left over.
zh: 街区派对花了一千二，我们筹了一千四百五，所以还剩一点。

en: I can't speak for everyone, but I can tell you what I've seen with my own eyes.
zh: 我不能代表所有人，但我可以告诉你我亲眼所见的事。

en: Maybe the answer isn't a new committee; maybe it's just a shared calendar.
zh: 也许答案不是成立一个新委员会；也许只是一个共享日历。

en: She left the meeting early, so we don't know if she supports the proposal.
zh: 她提前离开了会议，所以我们不知道她是否支持这项提案。

en: If we don't train the new volunteers, they'll quit within 3 weeks.
zh: 如果我们不培训新志愿者，他们会在三周内退出。

en: The food drive collected 950 cans, short of our 1,000-can goal.
zh: 食品募捐收集了九百五十罐，没有达到我们一千罐的目标。

en: He's not a natural speaker, but he's honest, and that's why people trust him.
zh: 他不是天生的演讲者，但他诚实，这就是人们信任他的原因。

en: We'll meet at 6:30 by the east gate—unless it's raining, then we'll meet inside.
zh: 我们六点半在东门集合——除非下雨，那就在里面集合。

en: The old playground was torn down 2 years ago, and nothing has replaced it.
zh: 旧游乐场两年前被拆了，之后什么也没建起来替代它。

en: I'm not sure the numbers add up, but I'm sure the need is real.
zh: 我不确定这些数字对不对得上，但我确定需求是真实的。

en: If you want to lead, start by putting away the chairs when everyone else leaves.
zh: 如果你想领导，就从别人都离开时把椅子收好开始。

en: We asked for 3 things; they gave us 1, and we're still negotiating the other 2.
zh: 我们要求三件事；他们给了我们一件，另外两件我们还在谈。

en: I thought I was over it, but seeing her name pop up on my phone made my chest tighten all over again.
zh: 我以为我已经放下了，但看到她的名字在手机上弹出来，我的胸口又紧了起来。

en: He said he was fine, but his voice cracked on the last word, and I knew he wasn't.
zh: 他说他没事，但最后一个字声音破了，我就知道他有事。

en: Don't tell me to calm down. You're not the one who has to live with this every single day.
zh: 别叫我冷静。你不是那个每天都要忍受这个的人。

en: I'm not sad, exactly. It's more like I'm numb, and I can't tell if that's better or worse.
zh: 我不是难过，确切地说。更像是麻木了，我说不清这是更好还是更糟。

en: She laughed it off in front of everyone, but later that night she cried in the bathroom with the faucet running.
zh: 她在大家面前一笑而过，但那天晚上她在浴室里开着水龙头哭了。

en: If you had just listened for five minutes instead of trying to fix everything, I might have opened up.
zh: 如果你当时只是听我说五分钟，而不是急着解决一切，我可能就敞开心扉了。

en: I keep replaying that conversation in my head, wondering if I said something wrong.
zh: 我一直在脑子里回放那次对话，想着是不是我说错了什么。

en: It's not that I don't trust you. It's that I've been burned before, and my brain won't let me forget it.
zh: 不是我不信任你。是我以前被伤过，我的脑子不让我忘记。

en: He apologized, but it felt like he was just going through the motions, so I didn't really believe him.
zh: 他道歉了，但感觉他只是走个过场，所以我并不真的相信他。

en: I wish I could tell you how I really feel, but every time I try, the words get stuck in my throat.
zh: 我希望我能告诉你我真实的感受，但每次我尝试，话就卡在喉咙里。

en: You can't just say 'I'm sorry' and expect everything to go back to normal. It doesn't work that way.
zh: 你不能只说一句“对不起”就指望一切恢复正常。事情不是那样的。

en: She's been acting distant lately, and I'm not sure if it's something I did or if she's just going through her own stuff.
zh: 她最近有点疏远，我不确定是我做错了什么，还是她自己在经历一些事情。

en: I didn't cry because I was weak. I cried because I had been strong for too long.
zh: 我哭不是因为我软弱。我哭是因为我坚强太久了。

en: He kept saying he was okay, but his hands were shaking, and he wouldn't look me in the eye.
zh: 他一直说他没事，但他的手在抖，而且他不肯看我的眼睛。

en: Maybe I'm overreacting, but it really hurt when you forgot my birthday again.
zh: 也许我反应过度了，但你又忘了我的生日，这真的很伤人。

en: I don't need you to solve my problems. I just need you to sit with me and not say anything.
zh: 我不需要你解决我的问题。我只需要你坐在我旁边，什么都别说。

en: She said she forgave me, but I can still feel the distance between us, and it's killing me.
zh: 她说她原谅我了，但我还是能感觉到我们之间的距离，这让我很难受。

en: If I let myself feel everything, I'm afraid I'll fall apart and never be able to put myself back together.
zh: 如果我让自己感受一切，我怕我会崩溃，再也无法把自己拼回来。

en: He didn't have to say anything. The look on his face told me everything I needed to know.
zh: 他什么都不用说。他脸上的表情已经告诉了我需要知道的一切。

en: I'm not angry at you. I'm angry at myself for letting you treat me that way for so long.
zh: 我不是生你的气。我是生我自己的气，让你那样对待我那么久。

en: It's hard to ask for help when you've been taught that needing anyone is a sign of weakness.
zh: 当你被教导需要任何人都是软弱的表现时，很难开口求助。

en: She smiled and said she was happy for me, but her eyes didn't match her words.
zh: 她笑着说她为我高兴，但她的眼神和她说的话不一致。

en: I thought time would heal it, but some wounds just get deeper the more you try to ignore them.
zh: 我以为时间会治愈它，但有些伤口你越试图忽视，就越深。

en: You keep saying you'll change, but I've heard that promise so many times that it doesn't mean anything anymore.
zh: 你一直说你会改，但那句承诺我听过太多次了，已经没有任何意义了。

en: I'm not sure if I'm ready to talk about it yet. Can we just sit here for a while?
zh: 我不确定我是否准备好谈这件事了。我们能就在这里坐一会儿吗？

en: He said he didn't care, but I saw him flinch when her name came up.
zh: 他说他不在乎，但她的名字出现时我看到他缩了一下。

en: I've been pretending to be okay for so long that I don't even know what okay feels like anymore.
zh: 我假装没事太久了，以至于我都不知道没事是什么感觉了。

en: If you're not going to take this seriously, then I don't know why we're still talking.
zh: 如果你不打算认真对待这件事，那我不知道我们为什么还在谈。

en: She didn't say a word, but her silence spoke louder than any accusation could.
zh: 她一个字都没说，但她的沉默比任何指责都更响亮。

en: I know I push people away, but it's because I'm terrified of being left behind again.
zh: 我知道我会把人推开，但那是因为我害怕再次被抛下。

en: He apologized, and I accepted it, but a part of me is still waiting for him to do it again.
zh: 他道歉了，我接受了，但我的一部分还在等着他再犯。

en: You don't have to fix me. You just have to be here and not run away when it gets messy.
zh: 你不需要修复我。你只需要在这里，在事情变得糟糕时不要跑开。

en: I'm not saying I'm perfect. I'm saying I deserve someone who doesn't make me feel small.
zh: 我不是说我是完美的。我是说我值得一个不会让我觉得自己渺小的人。

en: She told me she was fine, but I could hear the tears behind her voice.
zh: 她告诉我她没事，但我能听到她声音背后的泪水。

en: I've been holding this in for so long that I don't even know how to let it out anymore.
zh: 我把这个憋了太久了，以至于我都不知道该怎么释放出来了。

en: If you had been there for me when I needed you, I wouldn't be so guarded now.
zh: 如果在我需要你的时候你在我身边，我现在就不会这么防备了。

en: He said he loved me, but his actions told a different story, and I chose to believe his words.
zh: 他说他爱我，但他的行为讲述了不同的故事，而我选择相信他的话。

en: I'm not crying because I'm sad. I'm crying because I'm exhausted from pretending to be strong.
zh: 我哭不是因为我难过。我哭是因为我假装坚强已经精疲力尽了。

en: She didn't have to apologize. I just wanted her to acknowledge that she hurt me.
zh: 她不必道歉。我只想让她承认她伤害了我。

en: I know it's not fair to expect you to read my mind, but sometimes I wish you would just know.
zh: 我知道指望你读我的心是不公平的，但有时候我希望你就是知道。

en: He kept his distance, and I told myself I didn't care, but I checked my phone every five minutes.
zh: 他保持距离，我告诉自己我不在乎，但我每五分钟就看一次手机。

en: I'm not ready to forgive you yet, and that's okay. I'm allowed to take my time.
zh: 我还没准备好原谅你，这没关系。我有权慢慢来。

en: You said you'd never leave, but here I am, alone again, wondering what I did wrong.
zh: 你说你永远不会离开，但如今我又独自一人，想着我做错了什么。

en: I don't want to talk about it right now... maybe later.
zh: 我现在不想谈这个……也许以后吧。

en: I just need a minute... please.
zh: 我只需要一分钟……求你了。

en: It's not what you think... I swear.
zh: 不是你想的那样……我发誓。

en: I can't do this anymore... I'm sorry.
zh: 我再也做不到了……对不起。

en: I thought you knew... I guess not.
zh: 我以为你知道……看来不是。

en: I'm fine... really, I am.
zh: 我没事……真的，我没事。

en: Don't... just don't.
zh: 别……就别这样。

en: I wish I could... but I can't.
zh: 我希望我能……但我不能。

en: My legs felt like lead after that hill, so I just walked the last mile instead of running it.
zh: 爬完那个坡之后我的腿沉得像灌了铅，所以最后一英里我干脆走了，没跑。

en: If you didn't sleep well, don't force a hard workout; a short walk might do more for your brain than pushing through.
zh: 如果你没睡好，就别硬撑着做高强度训练；短时间散步对大脑的好处可能比硬扛着练更大。

en: I thought lifting weights would make me bulky, but after six months I mostly just feel steadier on my feet.
zh: 我原以为举铁会让我变得很壮，但六个月后，我主要的感觉是站得更稳了。

en: She swims three times a week, not because she loves the water, but because her knees can't handle running anymore.
zh: 她每周游三次泳，不是因为她喜欢水，而是因为她的膝盖已经受不了跑步了。

en: Wait, so the dizziness after standing up quickly... is that something I should worry about or not?
zh: 等等，那站起来太快之后的头晕……这到底是我该担心的事，还是不用管？

en: Honestly, I can't tell if the stretching is helping my back or if it's just the extra sleep.
zh: 说实话，我分不清是拉伸对我的背有帮助，还是只是因为我多睡了觉。

en: He cycles about 40 kilometers every weekend, but his resting heart rate hasn't changed much since last year.
zh: 他每个周末骑大约40公里，但自从去年以来，他的静息心率没怎么变。

en: You don't have to run a marathon to protect your memory; even 20 minutes of brisk walking several times a week seems to help.
zh: 你不必跑马拉松来保护记忆；每周快走几次、每次哪怕20分钟，似乎也有帮助。

en: My coach keeps saying rest is part of training, and I'm starting to think he might actually be right.
zh: 我的教练一直说休息也是训练的一部分，我开始觉得他可能真的是对的。

en: After the concussion, bright screens gave her headaches, so she listened to podcasts instead of watching videos.
zh: 脑震荡之后，亮屏幕让她头痛，所以她改听播客，而不是看视频。

en: Does anyone else feel weirdly foggy the day after a really long ride... or is it just me?
zh: 还有谁在超长骑行之后的第二天会觉得脑子怪怪地发懵……还是只有我这样？

en: I used to think balance exercises were boring, but now I do them while waiting for the kettle to boil.
zh: 我以前觉得平衡练习很无聊，但现在我会在等水壶烧开的时候做。

en: The study followed 120 adults for 18 months, and those who exercised twice a week scored slightly better on attention tests.
zh: 这项研究跟踪了120名成年人18个月，每周锻炼两次的人在注意力测试中得分略高。

en: Don't skip the warm-up, especially if you've been sitting all day; your muscles aren't ready for sudden sprinting.
zh: 别跳过热身，尤其是如果你已经坐了一整天；你的肌肉还没准备好突然冲刺。

en: He says his mind is clearer after a swim, though he can't prove it and doesn't really try to.
zh: 他说游完泳后头脑更清醒，虽然他证明不了，也并不真的想去证明。

en: If your knee hurts during squats, stop and check your form rather than adding more weight.
zh: 如果深蹲时膝盖疼，就停下来检查动作姿势，而不是继续加重量。

en: Three flights of stairs, twice a day — that's it. That's my whole routine right now.
zh: 三层楼梯，一天两趟——就这样。这就是我现在的全部锻炼。

en: I'm not sure the breathing exercises calm me down, but they do make me notice how tense I am.
zh: 我不确定呼吸练习是否让我平静下来，但它们确实让我注意到自己有多紧张。

en: She jogs slowly for 25 minutes and then stretches for 10, and she says that's enough for her.
zh: 她慢跑25分钟，然后拉伸10分钟，她说这对她来说就够了。

en: Unless you're training for something specific, you probably don't need to track every single calorie.
zh: 除非你在为某个特定目标训练，否则你大概不需要记录每一卡路里。

en: My grandfather walks two miles every morning, rain or shine, and he's sharper than most people half his age.
zh: 我爷爷每天早上走两英里，风雨无阻，他比大多数只有他一半年纪的人还头脑清楚。

en: The gym was so crowded that I gave up and did a few push-ups at home instead.
zh: 健身房太挤了，我干脆放弃，改在家做了几个俯卧撑。

en: It's not that cardio is useless for the brain; it's that strength training gets overlooked too often.
zh: 并不是说有氧运动对大脑没用；而是力量训练太常被忽视了。

en: Hmm, maybe the trick isn't exercising more, but exercising at the same time every day...
zh: 嗯，也许诀窍不是练得更多，而是每天在同样的时间锻炼……

en: He hurt his shoulder lifting too heavy too soon, and it took almost four months to recover.
zh: 他太早举得太重，伤了肩膀，花了将近四个月才恢复。

en: Even ten minutes of dancing in the kitchen counts, and it's certainly more fun than the treadmill.
zh: 哪怕在厨房里跳十分钟舞也算数，而且肯定比跑步机有意思。

en: I can't run anymore because of my ankle, but I can still bike and swim without much pain.
zh: 因为脚踝的问题，我不能再跑步了，但我仍然可以骑车和游泳，不太疼。

en: Do you think memory problems from stress can improve with exercise, or is that just wishful thinking?
zh: 你觉得压力造成的记忆问题能通过锻炼改善吗，还是那只是一厢情愿？

en: She took a rest day, not because she was lazy, but because her body was clearly asking for it.
zh: 她休息了一天，不是因为她懒，而是因为她的身体明显在要求休息。

en: After two weeks of daily walks, he noticed he was less irritable in the evenings, though nothing else changed.
zh: 每天散步两周后，他注意到自己晚上没那么烦躁了，虽然其他方面没什么变化。

en: You should probably see a doctor about that tingling, especially since it hasn't gone away in a month.
zh: 你大概应该去看医生，查查那个刺痛感，尤其是它已经一个月没消了。

en: I keep a jump rope by the desk, and whenever I feel stuck, I do 50 skips and come back.
zh: 我在桌边放了一根跳绳，每当我卡住的时候，就跳50下，然后再回来。

en: The class was supposed to be gentle yoga, but it left me sore for two days.
zh: 那节课本来应该是温和的瑜伽，但让我酸痛了两天。

en: If you're new to running, don't compare your pace to anyone else's; just finish the distance.
zh: 如果你刚开始跑步，别拿自己的配速跟别人比；先把距离跑完就行。

en: His doctor told him to move more, but didn't specify how, so he started with marching in place during commercials.
zh: 他的医生让他多活动，但没说具体怎么动，于是他就开始在广告时间原地踏步。

en: Wait, you mean the brain benefits show up even without losing weight? That changes things.
zh: 等等，你是说即使没减重，大脑的益处也会出现？那就不一样了。

en: She can't do high-impact exercise, so she uses a stationary bike and light dumbbells instead.
zh: 她不能做高冲击运动，所以她改用固定自行车和轻哑铃。

en: Some days I feel strong, and other days a single flight of stairs feels like a mountain.
zh: 有些日子我觉得自己很强壮，另一些日子上一层楼梯都像爬一座山。

en: The research isn't settled yet, so I wouldn't treat any single workout as a cure for anything.
zh: 研究还没有定论，所以我不会把任何单一锻炼当成能治什么病的灵丹妙药。

en: He tried meditating after his run, but he kept falling asleep, so now he does it before.
zh: 他试过跑步后冥想，但总是睡着，所以现在改成跑前做。

en: Twenty push-ups, a one-minute plank, and that's all I can manage today... and that's okay.
zh: 二十个俯卧撑，一分钟平板支撑，今天我只能做到这些……而这也没关系。

en: If the weather is bad, she walks laps inside the mall, which sounds silly but works for her.
zh: 如果天气不好，她就在商场里绕圈走，听起来有点傻，但对她管用。

en: I don't think exercise fixes everything, but I do notice I cope better on the days I move.
zh: 我不认为锻炼能解决一切，但我确实注意到，活动过的那些天我应对得更好。

en: They biked 15 miles on Saturday and 30 on Sunday, which was probably too much for beginners.
zh: 他们周六骑了15英里，周日骑了30英里，对新手来说这大概太多了。

en: My hands shake a little after a hard workout, but it goes away in about ten minutes.
zh: 剧烈锻炼后我的手会有点抖，但大约十分钟后就消失了。

en: Is it normal to feel emotionally better after lifting, or am I just imagining the mood boost?
zh: 举铁之后情绪变好是正常的吗，还是那种心情提升只是我的错觉？

en: She started with just five minutes of stretching each morning, and after a month she added ten more.
zh: 她一开始只是每天早上拉伸五分钟，一个月后她又加了十分钟。

en: Don't push through sharp pain; dull soreness is one thing, but a stabbing feeling is another.
zh: 别硬扛尖锐的疼痛；钝钝的酸痛是一回事，刺痛又是另一回事。

en: The more consistent I am, the less I care about how fast I'm going or how far.
zh: 我越坚持，就越不在乎自己跑得多快或多远。

en: He forgot his shoes, so he walked the whole route barefoot and regretted it by the end.
zh: 他忘了带鞋，就光脚走完了整条路线，到最后后悔了。

en: The cortisol levels in the saliva samples were higher than we expected, but that doesn't necessarily mean the participants were more stressed.
zh: 唾液样本中的皮质醇水平比我们预期的要高，但这并不一定意味着参与者的压力更大。

en: If the control group had slept at least seven hours, the results might have looked completely different.
zh: 如果对照组至少睡了七个小时，结果可能会完全不同。

en: I'm not saying stress causes ulcers, but the correlation in this dataset is hard to ignore.
zh: 我不是说压力会导致溃疡，但在这个数据集中的相关性很难忽视。

en: The heart rate variability readings were inconsistent, so we couldn't draw any firm conclusions from them.
zh: 心率变异性读数不一致，因此我们无法从中得出任何明确的结论。

en: Some participants reported feeling calmer after the intervention, while others said nothing changed at all.
zh: 一些参与者报告说干预后感觉更平静，而另一些人则说完全没有变化。

en: We measured blood pressure three times a day for two weeks, but the patients often forgot to log the evening readings.
zh: 我们每天测量血压三次，持续了两周，但患者常常忘记记录晚上的读数。

en: Unless the sample size increases, the findings probably won't hold up in a larger population.
zh: 除非样本量增加，否则这些发现可能无法在更大的人群中站得住脚。

en: The self-reported stress scores dropped by 12 percent, though the physiological markers stayed roughly the same.
zh: 自我报告的压力分数下降了12%，尽管生理指标大致保持不变。

en: It's unclear whether the breathing exercises actually lowered anxiety or if people just got used to the study routine.
zh: 目前还不清楚呼吸练习是否真的降低了焦虑，还是人们只是习惯了研究流程。

en: Don't assume that a single high cortisol reading means someone has a chronic stress problem.
zh: 不要假设一次高皮质醇读数就意味着某人有慢性压力问题。

en: The researchers excluded anyone who had taken anti-anxiety medication in the past six months.
zh: 研究人员排除了在过去六个月内服用过抗焦虑药物的任何人。

en: Although the meditation group showed improvement, the difference wasn't statistically significant.
zh: 尽管冥想组显示出改善，但差异在统计上并不显著。

en: We can't tell from this data whether the stress was caused by work, family, or something else entirely.
zh: 我们无法从这些数据判断压力是来自工作、家庭还是完全其他原因。

en: If you skip the follow-up questionnaire, we won't be able to include your results in the final analysis.
zh: 如果你跳过随访问卷，我们将无法把你的结果纳入最终分析。

en: The mice in the stressed group lost weight, but the ones in the control group did not.
zh: 压力组的小鼠体重下降了，但对照组的小鼠没有。

en: I doubt the new biomarker is ready for clinical use; the validation studies are still ongoing.
zh: 我怀疑这种新生物标志物尚未准备好用于临床；验证研究仍在进行中。

en: Either the questionnaire was too long, or the participants simply lost interest halfway through.
zh: 要么问卷太长，要么参与者中途就失去了兴趣。

en: The study lasted eight weeks, and participants wore the sensor for 16 hours each day.
zh: 这项研究持续了八周，参与者每天佩戴传感器16个小时。

en: We found no evidence that the supplement reduced stress, but we also can't rule out a small effect.
zh: 我们没有发现该补充剂减轻压力的证据，但也不能排除有微小效果。

en: While the therapy helped some patients, it made others feel more anxious, which was unexpected.
zh: 虽然这种疗法帮助了一些患者，却让另一些人感到更焦虑，这是出乎意料的。

en: The data suggest a link between poor sleep and elevated stress hormones, but correlation is not causation.
zh: 数据表明睡眠不足与压力激素升高之间存在关联，但相关不等于因果。

en: Had we controlled for caffeine intake, the results might have been less noisy.
zh: 如果我们控制了咖啡因摄入量，结果可能会更清晰。

en: Nobody in the low-stress group reported headaches, whereas six people in the high-stress group did.
zh: 低压力组中没有人报告头痛，而高压力组中有六人报告了头痛。

en: The device measures skin conductance, which is a indirect indicator of sympathetic nervous system activity.
zh: 该设备测量皮肤电导，这是交感神经系统活动的一个间接指标。

en: I'm not convinced the results are generalizable, since almost all participants were university students.
zh: 我不相信这些结果具有普遍性，因为几乎所有参与者都是大学生。

en: Whether the effects persist beyond six months is still an open question.
zh: 这些效果是否持续超过六个月仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

en: The intervention group showed a 9-point drop on the anxiety scale, compared with a 3-point drop in the control group.
zh: 干预组在焦虑量表上下降了9分，而对照组下降了3分。

en: We asked participants not to exercise, smoke, or drink coffee for two hours before the test.
zh: 我们要求参与者在测试前两小时内不要运动、吸烟或喝咖啡。

en: It's possible that the placebo effect explains part of the improvement, but not all of it.
zh: 安慰剂效应可能解释了部分改善，但并非全部。

en: The review paper concluded that the evidence is mixed and more rigorous trials are needed.
zh: 这篇综述论文的结论是证据不一，需要更严格的试验。

en: Although the participants reported feeling better, their cortisol levels remained elevated.
zh: 尽管参与者报告感觉更好，但他们的皮质醇水平仍然偏高。

en: If the sensor falls off during the night, the data for that subject will be incomplete.
zh: 如果传感器在夜间脱落，该受试者的数据将不完整。

en: We didn't measure stress directly; we only asked people how they felt over the past month.
zh: 我们没有直接测量压力；我们只是询问人们过去一个月的感受。

en: The difference between the two groups was small, and it disappeared after adjusting for age.
zh: 两组之间的差异很小，而且在调整年龄后差异消失了。

en: Some researchers argue that chronic stress accelerates cellular aging, but others remain skeptical.
zh: 一些研究人员认为慢性压力会加速细胞衰老，但其他人仍持怀疑态度。

en: The blood samples were stored at minus 80 degrees Celsius until they could be analyzed.
zh: 血液样本被储存在零下80摄氏度，直到可以进行分析。

en: I can't say whether the breathing technique will work for you; everyone responds differently.
zh: 我不能说这种呼吸技巧是否对你有用；每个人的反应都不同。

en: The participants who journaled daily reported lower stress, but they also tended to be more health-conscious overall.
zh: 每天写日记的参与者报告压力较低，但他们总体上也更注重健康。

en: Neither the yoga group nor the walking group showed a significant change in blood pressure.
zh: 瑜伽组和步行组均未显示血压的显著变化。

en: We need to replicate these findings in a larger, more diverse sample before making any recommendations.
zh: 在提出任何建议之前，我们需要在更大、更多样化的样本中重复这些发现。

en: The study was double-blind, so neither the participants nor the researchers knew who received the treatment.
zh: 这项研究是双盲的，因此参与者和研究人员都不知道谁接受了治疗。

en: It seems unlikely that a single relaxation app can reverse years of chronic stress.
zh: 一个放松应用程序似乎不太可能逆转多年的慢性压力。

en: The researchers found that social support buffered the effect of stress on mood, but only for women.
zh: 研究人员发现社会支持缓冲了压力对情绪的影响，但仅对女性有效。

en: Unless we account for socioeconomic factors, we're probably missing a big part of the picture.
zh: 除非我们考虑社会经济因素，否则我们可能遗漏了很大一部分情况。

en: The questionnaire asked about sleep, appetite, concentration, and how often people felt overwhelmed.
zh: 问卷询问了睡眠、食欲、注意力以及人们感到不堪重负的频率。

en: We observed a slight increase in heart rate during the stressful task, but it returned to baseline within five minutes.
zh: 我们在压力任务期间观察到心率略有增加，但在五分钟内恢复到基线。

en: I'm not sure the findings apply to older adults, since the oldest participant was 34.
zh: 我不确定这些发现是否适用于老年人，因为最年长的参与者是34岁。

en: The meta-analysis included 23 studies, but many of them had small sample sizes.
zh: 这项荟萃分析包括23项研究，但其中许多研究样本量较小。

en: If the effect is real, we should see it again when we run the experiment with a different population.
zh: 如果效应是真实的，当我们对不同人群进行实验时应该会再次看到它。

en: The participants were told they could withdraw at any time, and a few did.
zh: 参与者被告知他们可以随时退出，有几个人确实退出了。

en: I'm not saying the model is wrong, but I haven't seen enough evidence to trust its answer yet.
zh: 我不是说这个模型错了，只是我还没看到足够的证据来相信它的答案。

en: If the test passes locally but fails in production, don't just rerun it — figure out what's different about the environment.
zh: 如果测试在本地通过但在生产环境失败，别只是重跑一遍——要弄清楚环境有什么不同。

en: We rolled back the update at 3 a.m., and honestly, nobody knew whether the fix would hold until the morning.
zh: 我们凌晨三点回滚了更新，说实话，直到早上谁也不知道这个修复能不能撑住。

en: The logs are noisy, so it's hard to tell whether that spike was a real attack or just a bot crawling the site.
zh: 日志很杂乱，所以很难判断那次激增是真正的攻击，还是只是机器人在爬网站。

en: Can you check whether the backup actually finished? I don't want to assume it did.
zh: 你能确认一下备份是不是真的完成了吗？我不想当然地以为它完成了。

en: She spent two weeks tuning the prompts, and the accuracy went up by maybe three percent — not huge, but measurable.
zh: 她花了两周时间调提示词，准确率大概提高了三个百分点——不算大，但可以测量。

en: Unless someone reviews the permissions, that script could quietly delete files it was never supposed to touch.
zh: 除非有人审查这些权限，否则那个脚本可能会悄悄删掉本不该碰的文件。

en: I'd rather ship a slower model that we understand than a fast one that surprises us at midnight.
zh: 我宁愿上线一个我们了解得清楚的较慢模型，也不愿要一个半夜给我们惊喜的快速模型。

en: The dataset is biased, and no amount of clever math will fix that if we keep collecting the same way.
zh: 这个数据集是有偏的，如果我们还照老样子收集数据，再聪明的数学方法也解决不了。

en: Wait — did you say the server restarted twice, or only once after the patch?
zh: 等等——你是说服务器重启了两次，还是打补丁后只重启了一次？

en: It's not that the idea is bad; it's that we have no way to test it before Friday.
zh: 不是这个想法不好，而是我们在周五之前没办法测试它。

en: He argued that safety filters slow everything down, but the benchmarks show only a small delay.
zh: 他主张安全过滤器会拖慢一切，但基准测试显示只有很小的延迟。

en: If you can't explain why the model made that choice, you probably shouldn't deploy it to real users.
zh: 如果你无法解释模型为什么做出那个选择，你大概就不该把它部署给真实用户。

en: Three engineers, two days, one bug — and we still aren't sure it's gone for good.
zh: 三名工程师，两天时间，一个漏洞——我们仍然不确定它是不是彻底消失了。

en: The interface looks fine on my laptop, but on a phone the buttons overlap...
zh: 这个界面在我的笔记本电脑上看起来没问题，但在手机上按钮会重叠……

en: Don't promise the client a date until you've checked how long the migration actually takes.
zh: 在你确认迁移实际需要多长时间之前，别向客户承诺日期。

en: Maybe the outage was caused by the certificate expiring, or maybe someone changed the firewall rules.
zh: 也许这次故障是证书过期引起的，也可能是有人改了防火墙规则。

en: We need a human in the loop for anything that touches money, health, or personal data.
zh: 任何涉及金钱、健康或个人数据的事情，我们都需要有人在环路中把关。

en: I told him the shortcut would break later, and sure enough, it broke two releases down the line.
zh: 我告诉过他那个捷径以后会出问题，果不其然，两个版本之后它就崩了。

en: The team disagreed about whether to log user prompts, so they postponed the decision.
zh: 团队对是否记录用户提示词意见不一，于是推迟了决定。

en: It works, but only if the input is clean — and real inputs are almost never clean.
zh: 它能用，但前提是输入是干净的——而真实输入几乎从来都不干净。

en: How many false positives did we get last month, and how many of those did a human have to review?
zh: 上个月我们得到了多少误报，其中又有多少必须由人工审核？

en: The new hire asked a simple question that none of us could answer, which was a little embarrassing.
zh: 新来的同事问了一个简单的问题，我们谁都答不上来，这有点尴尬。

en: Rather than block every unusual request, the system flags it and lets a reviewer decide.
zh: 系统不会拦截每一个异常请求，而是把它标记出来，让审核人员决定。
